cards.card_text: And they say many other blasphemous things against Him.
cards.verse_text: And they said many other blasphemous things against Him.
cards.snippet: And they said many other blasphemous things against Him.

cards.card_text: On its seven heads are blasphemous names, and the beast is like a leopard, with the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion.
cards.verse_text: There were ten royal crowns on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads.
cards.snippet: There were ten royal crowns on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads.

cards.card_text: The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words.
cards.verse_text: The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.
cards.snippet: The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.
